items.Title: Password policy
items.Hint: Account Policies > Password Policy. Capture the whole list of settings.

items.Title: Audit policy
items.Hint: Local Policies > Audit Policy: every category set to Success, Failure.

items.Title: Logon warning message
items.Hint: Local Policies > Security Options > 'Interactive logon: Message text / Message title for users attempting to log on'. Select both rows.

items.Title: Idle time before the session is locked
items.Hint: Power Options > Change plan settings: display and sleep timeouts.

items.Title: User information hidden on the lock screen
items.Hint: Local Policies > Security Options > 'Interactive logon: Display user information when the session is locked'.

items.Title: BitLocker - authentication at startup
items.Hint: Administrative Templates > Windows Components > BitLocker Drive Encryption > Operating System Drives ('Require additional authentication at startup - Enabled').
items.Node: Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > BitLocker Drive Encryption > Operating System Drives

items.Title: System information
items.Hint: DirectX Diagnostic Tool > System tab (computer name, OS, CPU, memory).

items.Title: Failed logon events
items.Hint: Security log filtered by event 4625. Select an event so that the details pane is visible.
